entries.title: Burnhouse Lane

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the earliest native release and best capture/fidelity route, while the later PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch ports have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Burnhouse Lane on Steam for the primary route. Use PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, or Switch only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original PC release followed by Feardemic console ports; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
